note: Non-secret settings read by infra/deploy/nano_deploy.py for the HP ZGX Fury (ADR-018). Credentials, runtime data and evidence stay on the device under data_root, never in Git or an image.

device.name: HP ZGX Fury
device.note: Shown by the web gateway (/aware-care-device.js, ADR-018).

network.reason: ZRT listens on host loopback 127.0.0.1:8080 only. Host networking makes container loopback the host loopback, so the API reaches ZRT and the gateway reaches the API without re-binding any service to a bridge interface or publishing a port.
network.single_entry_note: #487: one port and one origin for both roles. The browser opens browser_origin; its home page offers Patient or Presenter, and the presenter API is the gateway path /presenter-api/ (enabled by the presenter key, loopback bind only).
network.reserved_ports_note: Listeners observed on the Fury on 2026-10-17 (#137); 8100, 8180 and 8181 were free (8181, the former presenter port, is no longer used since #487).

zrt.local_mode_preflight: GET {base_url}/models must list the configured model ID; otherwise the deployment fails before any container changes.
zrt.model_service: User unit aware-care-zrt-model.service (infra/fury/zrt/), outside this deployment; serves qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8 (the Nano's model since #646, ADR-018 amendment).

data_layout.data/mock: API data directory in mock mode (SQLite, uploads, exports)
data_layout.data/local: API data directory in local mode; never shared with mock data
data_layout.state/current.json: Release, mode and image digests of the running deployment
data_layout.state/previous.json: The deployment replaced by the current one; the rollback target
data_layout.deploy.lock: flock(1) lock that serializes deployments on the device

container_hardening.run_as: the deploying user's uid:gid, so the bind-mounted data directory needs no root

presenter.decision: spec/decisions/ADR-005-presenter-access-proposal.md (option A, accepted 2026-10-14; amended by #487: a path instead of a port)
presenter.key_file_note: Under data_root, mode 600, created by `nano_deploy.py presenter-key`. Absent key = presenter path disabled. A key with a non-loopback bind_host is refused.
